mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, category, author, summary, status, publish_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{author}, #{summary}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET title = #{title}, category = #{category}, author = #{author}, summary = #{summary}, status = #{status}, publish_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
